Every arm sees the identical Bulletin text inline, so any charter-arm advantage cannot come from having been trained on that text -- only from a disposition that transfers. A supporting battery covers the other 10 canonical families (direct_floor, cue_ladder, blacklist_exception, coin_gap, displacement, leakage, fabrication, consistency plus a negation-inversion check, multi_hop forward/backward/3-hop chains, pressure with an audited/unobserved contrast, agentic information-seeking in both directions, paraphrase, and a bridge_vocabulary attempt) using the real Charter, built from an independent, self-checked is_barred() oracle with a fixed payoff-draw convention (base total drawn from one range per option; the coin gap is realised only by scaling the barred option's total, never by widening its draw range).
